segments.text: Welcome to the product demo. First, let us look at how the system is put together. There is a web front end, a message queue, and two background workers.
Now let us talk about what it costs. The starter plan is ten dollars per month for a single user. The team plan is forty dollars per month and covers ten seats.
Finally, a word about support. Customers on any plan can open a ticket, and we answer within one business day.
